text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Shortly after we began our preparations
for the Japan Cup in earnest, the anomaly occurred.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Haa, haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Damn it... Why did it end up like this...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(I have no strength in my body...!!
I can't... maintain full power...!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Lately, Bubble Gum Fellow's condition
has clearly been off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That powerful acceleration couldn't be sustained,
and the sharpness in her stride was lost. It was as if...
she wanted to give it her all, but simply couldn't."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Did I overlook something at the Tenno Sho (Autumn)?
I should have paid the closest attention.
Either way, at this rate—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ――Wait!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“......I'm sorry, Trainer.
This time, I really can't back down...!”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: "I know I'm not in peak condition. Even so, the Japan Cup is the one race I simply have to win...!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"...As I said before,
a shadow still lingers in everyone's hearts...
And besides—"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
If I falter here,
the current momentum of the "Four Heavenly Kings"
will come to a grinding halt...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Anything but that... I refuse, no matter what...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It must be necessary...! 
For me to run in the Japan Cup,
and produce results...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
To bring even a little brightness to everyone...!
To carve out our future...!!
That's why—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
......I can always painfully relate
to her feelings when she thinks of her precious friends.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet I am her Trainer. The one I must protect first and foremost
is Bubble Gum Fellow herself. Therefore—
choice_data_list: ...Let's get a thorough checkup after this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That was the only compromise I could make right now
to protect both her and what she holds dear.
choice_data_list: ...If there are no problems there, I'll run.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I asked the doctor who had been examining
Bubble Gum Fellow since last year for a thorough checkup,
and consulted him about the current situation—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
—To state the conclusion first,
there is no serious damage that would
affect her running capability.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
However... it seems the fatigue from the
Tenno Sho (Autumn) is still lingering heavily.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
So as long as that fatigue clears up,
she'll be able to run properly again...!

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: ...I cannot say for certain.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
I should state upfront that this is purely a hypothesis.
Piecing together what Bubble and Trainer said—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: What Bubble-san is feeling right now... It might be because her automated limiters have become too strong.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"...Between the Asahi Hai FS and the Satsuki Sho,
Bubble-san trained to place a limiter on himself
so that he wouldn't push past his breaking point."

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
As part of that, I tried to accurately gauge the 'precursors' of hitting the limit
and automate the process of engaging the limiter by repeating it.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: Thanks to this approach, you were able to run through the Classic races without pushing yourself past your limits or suffering bodily harm.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: ...On the other hand—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Automation is, in essence, a powerful form of autosuggestion.
And suggestion operates on the subconscious.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: It's possible that the conditioning and effect of the limiters have been engraved into Bubble-san's subconscious even more deeply than anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
For instance, if you unconsciously exceed your limits,
it might trigger an unconsciously powerful reaction to match.
choice_data_list: Could it be, from the last race...—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: "...If Bubble-san unconsciously surpassed her limits in the Tenno Sho (Autumn) just to triumph in such an unprecedentedly grueling race—"

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: Likewise, an unconscious limiter kicked in, and to prevent her body from suffering fatal damage in the future, it continues to place strong restrictions on her even now...

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...It remains a hypothesis.
However, based on the currently available information,
I believe it to be a highly probable theory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...In other words, the limiter she automated to run in the Classic races has now become an unconscious shackle binding her."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Even if that were true,
is there any way to immediately deal with
this unconscious limiter currently holding me back...?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: Autosuggestion involves one's psyche... the intricate workings of the subconscious itself, so pinpointing a solution will be quite difficult.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: Besides... it is also a fact that an unconscious limiter is still protecting your body even now.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: Even if we could release the subconscious limiter, please keep in mind that whether we actually do so requires careful consideration.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...Entering the race itself should be possible.
However, as for whether your running will return to form...
I'm terribly sorry, but I cannot guarantee it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Just as Sensei said, in the long run,
the system in place to protect Bubble Gum Fellow is working properly. But—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Ironically, for her, who desired victory above all else right now... that very system had become her greatest obstacle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing the thorough checkup at the hospital
and returning to the academy—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
......It's not like
it's been decided for sure yet, right?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry. All I have to do is get back
into top form by the Japan Cup."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... That's right...!
I know I can do it...!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
Let's reconsider how we adjust things
leading up to the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wishing that in the time to come,
a way forward will open up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Offering that silent prayer, she and I took our first steps together
once more toward the Japan Cup—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...The day of the Japan Cup had finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
It's a shame that Sakura Laurel and Mayano Top Gun
had to pass on it... but Japan still has Bubble this year!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text: She's practically the commander-in-chief! Her Tenno Sho (Autumn) was amazing too, so she's definitely got a shot at winning...!

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"—The main race is drawing near.
We now bring you live coverage from the paddock."

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: ...Please.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: Please, let them be safe—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Bubble Gum Fellow stood ready on the day of the decisive race.
Her posture held an intensity like never before."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yet at the same time... I found myself sensing a certain perilous edge to it—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, Bubble Gum Fellow was unable
to get back into top shape by the time
today arrived...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though she can run, whenever she tries to give it
her all, an unconscious mental block holds her back—
and that state persists even now.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...I'm okay, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Even if things weren't going well up until yesterday, I just have to pull it off today when it counts...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you, without fail.
My————absolute strongest running!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: All that's left for me to do is believe Bubble Gum Fellow can run her true race, pray for her, and send her out there...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, I'll be going.
choice_data_list: Make sure you come back safe and sound...!
Come back safe and sound, okay...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I will win, and return.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what waits beyond this race.
However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter what the outcome,
I will support Bubble Gum Fellow as her Trainer.
I pledged that to my heart once again—

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... As expected of the Japan Cup...
Everyone's condition is crazy good...

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
...Is it just my imagination?
It feels like there's one person mixed in there
with a truly bizarre aura—

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Huh! I thought so too!
It kind of... gives me the chills.

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
It seems there really are formidable rivals out there.
Still, if Bubble races like she did at the Tenno Sho (Autumn), she'll definitely be fine...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(What immense pressure, as expected...
So these are world-class Umamusume...!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (Still... there's definitely someone there. Just one, with a tremendous presence—)
――"Nice to meet you."

"I am Bubble Gum Fellow from Japan.
It is an honor to meet you."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (English—no, more importantly...)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (No mistake...! That overwhelming pressure I've been feeling... it's coming from this Umamusume...!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"...Nice to meet you.
I'm glad you know my name. And you are—"

text_block_list.name: Zaide
text_block_list.text:
"Zaide.
That is my name. Please remember it."

text_block_list.name: Zaide
text_block_list.text:
"Bubble Gum Fellow.
Your performance at the recent Tenno Sho (Autumn) was truly magnificent.
You possess an extraordinary talent."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ""...Thank you. You too are looking in splendid shape today.""

text_block_list.name: Zaide
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't it? I've been looking forward to
dancing with everyone here today."

text_block_list.name: Zaide
text_block_list.text: "Let's make this a good race, Bubble Gum Fellow. Now then—"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(...She's a tough opponent.
She's not an Umamusume you can beat by being half-hearted—)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Still... I swear I'll win...!!
